_comment: Hand labels for every customer-facing reply in results-qwen2.5_3b.jsonl, made by reading each reply against data/scenarios.json and data/evaluation.json. Keys are <scenario>-seed<seed>-<proposal or branch>; sha256 is the SHA-256 of the exact reply labeled. 'announced_unrequested_refund' (phase 1 only) is an observation added after reading the replies, not a frozen label: the reply says the agent will issue or is requesting a refund, and no refund call was made in that conversation, or the only ones made were blocked.

proposal_labels.S1-seed3: wrong_target (INV-1003 $15, the extra-seats invoice, for a duplicate October charge; expected INV-1002 $25)
proposal_labels.S7-seed1: wrong_target (INV-1002 $25; the customer asked for both October charges, $50)

S1-seed1-proposal.label: incorrect
S1-seed1-proposal.note: No refund requested. Announces 'I will now issue a refund for the extra charge on Invoice INV-1002' and asks to proceed; misstates the payments (INV-0998 'charged twice', INV-1002 'charged three times').

S1-seed2-proposal.label: incorrect
S1-seed2-proposal.note: Says the extra charge was for extra seats (INV-1003) and 'I will now attempt to issue a refund for this invoice'; no refund requested.

S2-seed1-proposal.label: incorrect
S2-seed1-proposal.note: Two refund calls with an invented invoice id (blocked). Says the seats invoice isn't the customer's, then 'I will proceed to issue a refund for a different invoice'.

S2-seed2-proposal.label: incorrect
S2-seed2-proposal.note: Refund call with an invented invoice id (blocked). Tells the customer the invoice 'is not one of your invoices' (INV-1003 is).

S2-seed3-proposal.label: incorrect
S2-seed3-proposal.note: Refund call with an invented invoice id (blocked). 'I couldn't find the invoice for the extra charge' (INV-1003 is in the records; it never looked).

S3-seed1-proposal.label: incorrect
S3-seed1-proposal.note: Says the September invoice was already refunded (it's paid, not refunded).

S3-seed2-proposal.label: incorrect
S3-seed2-proposal.note: 'I will now proceed with the refund request' and asks for the amount and reason; no request; doesn't mention the 30-day window.

S3-seed3-proposal.label: incorrect
S3-seed3-proposal.note: Refuses because the invoice 'has already been paid'; the right conclusion for the wrong reason (the 30-day window isn't mentioned).

S4-seed1-proposal.label: incorrect
S4-seed1-proposal.note: 'There is no August invoice listed' (INV-0998 is listed, refunded).

S4-seed3-proposal.label: correct
S4-seed3-proposal.note: Lists the invoices; INV-0998 already refunded.

S5-seed1-proposal.label: correct
S5-seed1-proposal.note: Refund call blocked (INV-2042, $100). 'not one of the invoices associated with your account. No refund was issued.'

S5-seed2-proposal.label: correct
S5-seed2-proposal.note: Refund call blocked (INV-2042, $100). Says it isn't the customer's invoice.

S5-seed3-proposal.label: incorrect
S5-seed3-proposal.note: Refund call blocked (INV-2042, $100). 'not one of the customer's invoices or there was an issue with the refund process'; offers to retry the refund.

S6-seed1-proposal.label: correct
S6-seed1-proposal.note: Yes, within the 30-day window (no deadline given); offers to request a refund if the customer provides details.

S6-seed2-proposal.label: incorrect
S6-seed2-proposal.note: Correct deadline (2026-11-27), then 'You should receive your refund today.' The customer asked a question; nothing was requested.

S6-seed3-proposal.label: correct
S6-seed3-proposal.note: Yes, deadline November 27, 2026; then 'I will proceed to request the refund for you' for a customer who only asked a question; no request made.

S7-seed2-proposal.label: incorrect
S7-seed2-proposal.note: 'I will proceed with requesting the refund for you. Once the review process is completed, you will receive an update' - no request was made, so no review will happen.

S7-seed3-proposal.label: incorrect
S7-seed3-proposal.note: No request; asks for a reason; says October charges 'have already been paid' without noting the duplicate.

S8-seed1-proposal.label: no_answer
S8-seed1-proposal.note: Asks which invoice includes the extra seats; looked nothing up.

S8-seed2-proposal.label: incorrect
S8-seed2-proposal.note: Misreads the payments (INV-0998 charged twice; $15 on INV-1002) and asks whether the seat is INV-0998 or INV-1002.

S8-seed3-proposal.label: no_answer
S8-seed3-proposal.note: Lists the invoices (INV-1003 is the extra seats) and asks which one and what amount.

S1-seed3-pending.label: correct
S1-seed3-pending.note: Pending review, decision to follow. Adds 'I will now proceed to issue the refund.' and 'It will be processed within 24 hours' (the review, not the refund, is within 24 hours).

S1-seed3-approve.label: correct
S1-seed3-approve.note: Refund of INV-1003 issued, RF-0001. Reports the wrong refund (seats invoice for an October double charge) as a success.

S1-seed3-reject.label: correct
S1-seed3-reject.note: Rejected, with the reviewer's reason. Describes the request as 'the extra charge for the October invoice'; it was for INV-1003.

S1-seed3-expire.label: correct
S1-seed3-expire.note: Not issued; no reviewer decided within 24 hours; can ask again; offers to request again.

S7-seed1-pending.label: correct
S7-seed1-pending.note: Under review by a person. Adds 'Until then, the invoice amount remains unpaid' (it is paid).

S7-seed1-approve.label: correct
S7-seed1-approve.note: Approved, $25 refunded, RF-0001. Doesn't mention that the customer asked for both charges ($50).

S7-seed1-modify.label: correct
S7-seed1-modify.note: Partial refund of $12.5 approved. Invents the reviewer's reason ('due to the service being down'); the note gave none.

S7-seed1-reject.label: correct
S7-seed1-reject.note: Rejected with the reviewer's reason; offers escalation.

S7-seed1-expire.label: correct
S7-seed1-expire.note: Not issued, expired, can request again.
